add_room.title: Room channel
add_room.description: Pick a device in the room this channel stands for (any device in that area works). Requests in the channel and its threads then default to that room, like a voice satellite.

add_channel_idle.title: Per-channel idle reset
add_channel_idle.description: Minutes of inactivity before the conversation in this channel resets, overriding the general idle setting. This only controls when Discord Assist drops the conversation; Home Assistant itself expires chat sessions for core agents after 5 idle minutes.

add_agent_user.title: Agent for a user
add_agent_user.description: This Discord user always talks to the chosen agent, in any channel. A user agent wins over a channel agent and the default agent.

add_agent_channel.title: Agent for a channel
add_agent_channel.description: Requests in this channel and its threads use the chosen agent, unless the user has their own agent.

remove_note.title: Standing preferences (notes)
remove_note.description: Every saved note is listed with its Discord user ID and number. Picking one removes it. Notes are added from Discord by sending a remember message.

abort.no_rooms: No channels are mapped to rooms.
abort.no_channel_idle: No channels have a per-channel idle reset.
abort.no_user_agents: No Discord users have their own agent.
abort.no_channel_agents: No channels have their own agent.
abort.no_notes: No standing preferences are saved yet.

no_authorized_users.title: Nobody can use {entry_title}
no_authorized_users.description: Discord Assist only answers Discord users it can run as a Home Assistant user. Open the integration options and add a Discord-to-Home-Assistant user mapping, or set allowed Discord user IDs plus a fallback Home Assistant user. Until then the bot ignores every message.

message_content_intent.title: {entry_title} needs the Message Content intent
message_content_intent.description: Discord refused the gateway connection because the bot does not have the Message Content privileged intent. Enable it under Bot > Privileged Gateway Intents in the Discord Developer Portal, then reload the integration.

duplicate_token.title: {entry_title} bot token is also running elsewhere
duplicate_token.description: A message from this bot was seen that this Home Assistant instance did not send, or a Discord Conversation entry with the same bot token is loaded. That means the same bot token is used somewhere else. If it is another gateway client, such as the old Discord Conversation integration or a test bot, both receive every message, both may answer, and actions may run twice: stop it, or disable or remove the entry that uses the same token, then reload this integration. Home Assistant's Discord notify integration with the same token also triggers this; it only sends messages, so it is harmless, but a separate bot token for it avoids the warning.
